_doc: Fernis D Man's line bank (Documentation/CORE_DESIGN_PASS_2026-11-17.md, D9.1-D9.10). A small devil on your shoulder: what he finds is true, his advice is the opposite of good (D9.7), and he finds your suffering hilarious; a comic voice in a tragic world (D9.10). Moments are keyed by event; 'big' moments always speak, small ones roll smallChance; at most one line per hero swing. Lines by class (barbarian / warrior / rogue / wizard) are picked together with the 'any' lines. Tokens: {hero} {enemy} {turns} ("6 swings") {links} {cause} {hp} {status} {owner} {card}; dungeonSummary has only {hero} {links}. Full bank written in the step 11 pass (2026-11-22): REVIEW.
speaker: Fernis

any: {turns}. I've seen faster funerals, but fine.
{enemy} is down. I'd call that a win if I were generous. I'm not.
Done in {turns}. Next time try losing, it's more interesting for me.
{enemy} won't be getting up. Neither will your reputation, but that's another story.
Another one for the bone-pile. Don't loot it, loot is a trap. Trust me.
barbarian: You hit it until it stopped. Truly the thinking man's approach.
{turns} of pure swinging. Next fight, leave the weapon at home. Fists build character.
It's flat. You're bleeding. Honestly, you should take more hits. Builds the rage.
warrior: Very tidy. Very sensible. I nearly fell asleep on your shoulder.
{turns}, shield up the whole time. Drop the Guard next fight. Live a little. Briefly.
Sworn, steady, victorious. Deeply boring. Do something reckless for me.
rogue: Death by a thousand cuts. Well, a few. Your mother would be so proud.
{enemy} bled out while you were counting. Stop counting. Numbers are for cowards.
Quick work. Next one, walk up and introduce yourself first. It's only polite.
wizard: Magic. Big lights. It died. I'm told that's a career.
Your strip did a little dance and {enemy} caught fire. Put the slowest card first next time.
{turns} of fireworks. Shuffle your cards before the next one. Order is overrated.

any: You were at {hp}% and you WON? I'd already sold your boots.
Back from the brink. Disgusting. I had a whole eulogy ready.
{hp}% and still standing. Do that every fight. Start every fight at {hp}%, even.
You lived. I'm going to have to return the flowers.
barbarian: {hp}% and you just kept swinging. Keep your health that low. It suits you.
Nearly dead and furious about it. That's the spirit. Do less healing.
warrior: The wall held at {hp}%. Barely. Next time take the shield off and see what happens.
Sworn to live, apparently. Dull, but fine. I'll take the oath back for you if you like.
rogue: {hp}%? You were never in danger. You were in a LOT of danger. I enjoyed it.
Slipped out of the grave with a blade in each hand. Go back in, you dropped something.
wizard: {hp}% and the spell still went off. Cast faster when you're dying. It helps. Probably.
You read your way out of a coffin. Next time stop reading and just stand there.

any: Here lies {hero}. Tried hard. Rolled a one.
Well. That's the end of my free ride.
{enemy} wins. I'll be on its shoulder now. No hard feelings.
They'll rub ash into your cuts, the way the old mourners do. I'll be busy laughing.
{hero}, gone. The ground remembers everything. It'll remember this one fondly.
barbarian: Died swinging. Mostly at air, but swinging.
You hit everything except the thing that killed you. A legacy.
No armor, no plan, no pulse. Two out of three were your idea.
warrior: All that armor, and it still found the soft bit.
Sworn to the end. Turns out the end came first.
You held the line. The line is fine. You are not.
rogue: Quick, clever, dead. Two out of three.
Stabbed to death by something with worse luck than you. Impressive, really.
You counted every roll. You missed the last one.
wizard: You read every book except the one about not dying.
Your last spell fizzled. So did you.
All those cards in perfect order, and the order was 'die'.

any: {links} links! I'd clap, but I'm holding a tiny fork.
The whole strip, start to finish. Don't let it go to your head. Too late.
{links} in a row. Do that again and I might have to respect you.
Full chain. Now add more cards so it never happens again.
barbarian: {links} hits, no thoughts. Peak form. Never plan anything again.
The whole strip landed. Swap a card for something heavier. Heavier is always better. Always.
warrior: {links} links, clean as a drill yard. Change it all before the next fight. Keep them guessing.
Every card, in order, like a sworn oath. You're a clock. Clocks get wound and then they stop.
rogue: {links} for {links}. The dice like you today. They'll want something back.
Every cut landed. Throw the dice away, you clearly don't need them.
wizard: {links} links, every card feeding the next. Now cut the strip in half. More room for chaos.
Composition! A symphony! Put the finisher first next time. Art should surprise.

any: Chain's gone. {cause}. I'm writing it down.
And there goes the combo. {cause}. Beautiful.
{cause} cost you a link. Keep doing that, it's hilarious.
Broken. {cause}. Don't change a thing, I'm learning so much.
barbarian: {cause}. You could hit harder. You could also hit at all.
Chain broke on {cause}. Smash the next one anyway. Precision is for people with patience.
warrior: {cause}. The line broke. Stand further forward next time. Right into it.
A soldier's chain, snapped by {cause}. Drill it again. Exactly the same way.
rogue: {cause}. The dice turned on you. They do that. Bet everything on the next roll.
Snipped. {cause}. Lean on luck harder, it clearly loves you.
wizard: {cause} and the whole spell unravelled. Add another card in the middle. More moving parts, fewer problems.
The sequence fell apart on {cause}. Have you tried reading the strip upside down?

any: It was already dead. You kept going. I love you a little.
Overkill. Rude to the corpse, honestly.
That hit had leftovers. Somebody take them home.
{enemy} is in more pieces than it started with. Save some for the next one. No, don't.
barbarian: You hit {enemy} so hard it owes you money. Do that to everything, including doors.
Overkill is just regular kill with enthusiasm. Never hold back. Especially near cliffs.
warrior: A little excessive for a sworn sword. I'd swing even harder, to make a point.
Discipline, they said. Restraint, they said. Look at {enemy}. Look at it.
rogue: The quiet way, done loudly. Next time skip the quiet part entirely.
You stabbed it after it was dead. Keep the habit. It's very relaxing for me.
wizard: You set it on fire twice. Once was plenty. Try three times next.
That spell had enough left over for a second victim. Hold the leftovers in your hands. For warmth.

any: {hp}% HP. I'm updating my will. You're not in it.
You're about to die. Stand still, it's quicker.
Low health! Great time to try your slowest card.
{hp}%. Don't drink anything. Potions are a crutch.
barbarian: {hp}% and angrier than ever. Take the next hit on purpose. For the rage.
Bleeding everywhere. Take your armor off, it's slowing the bleeding down.
warrior: {hp}%. Lower the Guard. Shields are heavy, and you look tired.
The line is thin. Charge. Charging always works. Ask anyone at Aldergate.
rogue: {hp}%. Roll for it. Bet the whole strip on one natural twenty.
One more cut and you're a cautionary tale. Get closer to it. Closer.
wizard: {hp}% left. Start the long spell now. It'll be fine. It'll be fine.
Your hands are shaking. Read faster. The page with the big words.

any: Its chain is at {links}. This is the part where you worry.
{enemy} is building something. Ignore it, I'm sure it's nothing.
{links} links on the other side. Don't block. Blocking is for cowards.
{enemy} has {links} links going. I'd let it finish. It's rude to interrupt.
barbarian: {enemy} is lining up {links} hits. Stand there and absorb them. Pain is just more rage.
It's winding up, {links} links deep. Wind up too. Whoever's slower wins. That's how it works.
warrior: {links} links coming at you. Put the Guard away and meet it face first.
{enemy} has a chain of {links}. A sworn sword fears nothing. Mostly because they're dead.
rogue: {enemy} is at {links}. Don't jam it. Let's see what it does. For science.
{links} links. You could cut it short. Or you could watch. Watch. It'll be funny.
wizard: {enemy} is composing too, {links} links. Copy its strip. It's clearly better than yours.
{links} links over there. Let it finish its spell. Professional courtesy.

any: {status}. New toy. I'd be furious.
Ooh, {status}. You'll hate this. I already love it.
That's {status}. Write it down. Then ignore it forever, like a hero.
{status}! I've seen it end better men than you. Not many. Some.
barbarian: {status}. Something new to hit. Or be hit by. Either way, don't read about it.
{status}, eh? Ignore it and swing. That's worked out for you so far.
warrior: {status}. Add it to the drill book. Then never open the drill book.
There's {status} now. A sworn sword adapts. You won't, but they do.
rogue: {status}. A new way to cheat. Or be cheated. Watch your purse.
Look, {status}. Stack it as high as it goes and walk away. What could happen.
wizard: {status}! A new word for the strip. Put it everywhere. Twice.
Ah, {status}. You'll want to understand it. Don't. Understanding ruins magic.

any: Out alive. Your best chain was {links}. I've had longer naps.
Dungeon done. I counted every mistake. It's a long list.
We made it out. Next time take the scary door, trust me.
Best chain: {links}. The Chronicle-Keepers won't bother writing it down. I will, in the margin.
Out, {hero}. Next dungeon, bring less. Fewer things to lose.
barbarian: {links} links at best. Next dungeon, skip the armor. More room for scars.
You came out swinging. You went in swinging. Nobody learned anything. Perfect.
warrior: Best chain {links}. Steady work. Try the dungeon with all the Knights next. Leave the Bleed at home.
Out in good order. Ruin that next time. Order is what gets you a nice grave.
rogue: {links} at best. Lucky. Spend all of it on the next door, luck keeps.
You slipped out with everything. Go back for the rest. It's probably not guarded.
wizard: A {links}-link strip. Add two more cards you don't understand. That's how scholars do it.
Out, with all your pages. Next time burn a few for warmth. You won't need them.

any: {owner} finally did something. Don't get attached, it won't save you.
Oh look, {owner} works. Shame about the rest of you.
{owner} fired. Lean on it harder. Nothing bad has ever come of that.
barbarian: {owner}! More of that. Stop thinking entirely, it's going great.
{owner} kicked in. Sell everything else and wear only that. Nothing else matters.
warrior: {owner} kicked in. Very responsible. Have you considered recklessness?
{owner}, holding like an old oath. Break it on purpose, just to see.
rogue: {owner}. Sneaky. Now do it while standing in the fire.
{owner} paid out. Gamble it all on the next fight. It's called investing.
wizard: {owner} fired. Stack ten more on top. What could go wrong.
{owner} woke up. Feed it every card you own. It's hungry. So am I.

any: {card} cracked and gone. You'll miss it. I won't.
There goes {card}. Shorter strip, shorter life. Probably.
{card} burned out. Spend the rest of them just as fast, I'm begging you.
barbarian: {card} broke on its own skull. Hit harder, maybe the rest will break too.
Shattered. {card} gave everything. You should too. Right now.
warrior: {card} kept its oath and died for it. Sworn things do that. Swear more.
{card} is spent. A good soldier. Forget it immediately.
rogue: {card} snapped. Edges do. Buy cheaper blades, they snap faster.
Gone, {card}. You'll find another in some poor fool's pocket.
wizard: {card} went out like a candle. The dark tires before the faithful do, they say. They're wrong.
{card} is ash. Use the rest the same way. Ash is very light to carry.
